_README: Hand-maintained OVERRIDES for the Perk Cards curve-tables page. Everything else (SPECIAL, race restriction, names, curve linkage, points) is pulled automatically from the PCRD + CURV exports by build_perk_cards_json.py. Only put a card here when you need to override the auto data: a renamed card (former), a nicer display name, a written 'understand the perk' sentence (explain), or corrected chart axis labels / units / decimals for a curve. Key each card by its PCRD_EDID (quotes stripped). Inside 'curves', key by the curve EDID.

ShotgunnerMasterBonus.explain: Shotgun Champ increases shotgun damage based on the number of projectiles your weapon fires. Each projectile provides an additional 10% damage bonus, scaling linearly with the number of projectiles fired.

AdrenalineBonus.explain: Adrenaline increases your damage with each kill. Each kill grants an additional damage bonus, scaling up to its cap as your kill streak climbs.

BarbarianBonus.explain: Barbarian's bonus scales with the input value, climbing fastest at low values and tapering off as it approaches its cap.

ScienceBonus.explain: Science scales an energy-damage multiplier with the input value, rising from its minimum toward its cap.
